title: In early blind Braille readers, visual cortex activity is tactile

statements.text: In early blind subjects, magnetic stimulation of visual cortex produced errors in Braille reading and tactile illusions, while in sighted subjects the same stimulation had no effect on touch, so the visual cortex of the early blind defers to its tactile input.

sources.quote: In the early blind subjects, TMS applied to visual cortex produced both errors in Braille reading and reports of tactile illusions
